 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Saturday's Serie A action kicks off at 15:00 with Torino-Lecce and Cagliari-Frosinone. 
 The Granata come into this game on the back of two consecutive defeats and have a chance to pick up points before the break, with Napoli and Lazio awaiting them at the end of November. Lecce, meanwhile, have suffered three straight defeats and urgently need to pull away from the relegation zone, which is just two points below them.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Cagliari also need to turn things around after five consecutive defeats and no wins since September 19; Frosinone, by contrast, have won their last two games and are unbeaten since October 10 (a 3-0 defeat to Napoli).
 Cagliari-Frosinone
 CAGLIARI (4-3-2-1): Caprile; Ze Pedro, Deiola, Kofler, Rodríguez; Romano, Adopo, Grandu; Trepy, Maldini; Mendy.
 FROSINONE (4-2-3-1): Palmisani, Oyono, Calvani, Monterisi, Bracaglia, Cichella, Calò, Ghedjemis, Schmid, Kvernadze, Bîrligea.
 A debut for Nicola Grandu, Cagliari's youngster born in 2006.
 Torino-Lecce
 TORINO (3-5-2): Perri; Comuzzo, Ismajli, Coco; Belghali, Vlasic, Bragança, Fitz-Jim, Cacciamani; Kulenovic, Simeone.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement LECCE (3-5-2): Falcone; D. Veiga, T. Gabriel, Gaspar; Dembelé, Kaba, Ngom, Maleh, Gallo; Stulic, Fatah.
